ending_commit_note: The ending commit is the single intentional commit 'fix: close paired runner M2 launch and export races' created on this branch; its hash is reported in the terminal response and cannot appear inside the object it commits.
environment_limitations: Controller process cgroup is /init.scope; no writable delegated cgroup v2 subtree is available to this UID from that membership
Aggregate CGROUP_V2_AND_RLIMIT therefore cannot be physically qualified on this host; RLIMIT remains the readiness mechanism

findings.closure: Production launch uses a trusted pipe gate inside the private mount helper before execve of the launcher. subprocess.Popen(preexec_fn=...) and child-side SIGSTOP are absent from the production path. Synthetic regular files are refused as cgroup.procs evidence. Real delegated cgroup v2 membership could not be exercised from this process (own cgroup is /init.scope; subtree creation returns EACCES).

physical_tests_skipped.why: probe_cgroup_delegation unavailable: process is in /init.scope and cannot create a writable cgroup subtree (EACCES)

findings.title: production cgroup-before-exec launch ordering

findings.closure: Every effect materialises onto PRIVATE_MOUNTNS_TMPFS retained by descriptor. host_can_pathname_reach is False. Same-UID peers cannot mutate the mounted effect view. Production run_command exports through the private mount path.
findings.title: same-UID host reachability of the private execution view

findings.closure: Export publishes a durable reservation before the first authorized-source mutation, journals each operation with pre-state revalidation, verifies final tree identity, and publishes receipt/reconciliation only after durability barriers. Concurrent independent mutation does not return APPLIED. Separate-process crash/restart recovery classifies from durable state alone and refuses automatic replay.
findings.title: durable, race-safe transactional export

test_counts_note: Live unittest discovery immediately before the intentional commit. One skipped test is the real delegated-cgroup physical qualification.
verdict_rationale: Overall VERIFIED requires all three findings VERIFIED_PHYSICAL. M2-B25 lacks real delegated-cgroup physical qualification on this host, so the terminal verdict is refusal despite honest bounded implementation of the launch gate and verified physical closure of M2-B26 and M2-B27.
